title: Smart Data Models - ERA ERATV - VehicleTypeAuthorisationApplication
description:
Vehicle Type Authorisation Case (era:VehicleTypeAuthorisationApplication's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): The request, as submitted by the Applicant in line with (EU)2018/545, to allow the vehicle type authorisation and/or the vehicle authorisation for placing on the market.
The application consists of one or more authorisation cases as described in Art. 14 of (EU)2018/545, and for authorisations before the Fourth Railway Package, a HistoricalAuthorisationCase must be used.

The outcome of the application process is a `era:VehicleAuthorisation` or `era:VehicleTypeAuthorisation`. Inherits attributes from era:Request (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VehicleTypeAuthorisationApplication'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isPreEngagementApplication.description: Property. Determines if the Application for Vehicle (Type) Authorisation is determining a preEngagementBaseline, and not yet the authorisation itself.

preEngagementBaseline.description: Relationship. Denotes the opinion on the approach proposed by the applicant in the pre-engagement application, including a determination of the version of the TSIs and national rules that are to be applied for the subsequent application for authorisation Target type (Document) is published under the era-rinf standard.

constitutedBy.description: Relationship. holds as a complete, independent, possibly sole part, embodies as one element of potentially more Target type (Case) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

requestFor.description: Relationship. aiming to be enabled to act as covered by the Permission and its conditions, by receiving Target type (Permission) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

status.description: Property. the status of the Request, or constituting Case(s), as it is being treated by the PermittingBody Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.
